riddles.riddle:
I have keys but open no locks.
I have space but no room.
You can enter, but you can't go outside.
What am I?

The more you take,
the more you leave behind.
What am I?

I have a neck but no head,
and a body but no arms.
What am I?

I have an eye but cannot see.
I'm sharp, and I help mend what's torn.
What am I?

I have four legs but cannot walk.
You eat your dinner on my back.
What am I?

I have teeth but cannot bite.
I tidy your hair each morning.
What am I?

The wetter I get,
the more I dry you.
What am I?

You must break me
before you can use me.
What am I?

I'm tall when I'm young
and short when I'm old.
What am I?

I have a thumb and four fingers,
but I am not alive.
What am I?

I have a bed but never sleep,
a mouth but never eat.
I run, yet I never walk.
What am I?

It always goes up
and never comes down.
What is it?

You can catch me but not throw me,
and I'll leave you sneezing.
What am I?

I have one head, one foot, and four legs,
yet I cannot move.
What am I?

I travel all around the world
while staying in one corner.
What am I?

I'm a building with countless stories,
yet nothing dramatic happens here.
What am I?

I'm full of words but never speak.
Open me and I'll take you anywhere.
What am I?

I have cities but no houses,
mountains but no trees,
and water but no fish.
What am I?

I'm full of holes,
yet I still hold water.
What am I?

I go up when the rain comes down.
What am I?

I follow you all day
but vanish in the dark.
What am I?

I show you yourself,
but your left is my right.
What am I?

You can hear me and feel me,
but you will never see me.
What am I?

I go up and down
but never move.
What am I?

I have many layers,
and I might make you cry.
What am I?

I'm born in winter
and die in the sun.
What am I?

I have a face and two hands,
but no arms or legs.
What am I?

I have many keys
but open not a single door.
What am I?

I have ears but cannot hear.
I grow tall in a field.
What am I?

I have a tongue and a sole,
but I never speak or think.
What am I?

I float in the sky,
and when I'm heavy I bring rain.
What am I?

I arch across the sky
after the rain, in seven colours.
What am I?

I have bark but never bite,
a trunk but I'm not a car.
What am I?

I rise in the east,
set in the west,
and give the day its light.
What am I?

I twinkle in the dark,
far away and small,
yet I'm a giant ball of fire.
What am I?

I speak without a mouth
and hear without ears.
I come alive with the wind.
What am I?

What begins and ends with the letter E
but holds just one letter inside?

I'm so fragile that
saying my name breaks me.
What am I?

I have a head and a tail
but no body at all.
What am I?

I come once in a minute,
twice in a moment,
but never in a thousand years.
What am I?

I'm always in front of you
but can never be seen.
What am I?

You can give me to someone
and still keep me.
What am I?

The more you take away from me,
the bigger I become.
What am I?

It belongs to you,
but others use it more than you do.
What is it?

I run through towns and over hills,
yet I never move an inch.
What am I?

I have a thousand needles
but cannot sew.
I thrive where rain is rare.
What am I?

I let you look right through a wall
without ever making a hole.
What am I?

I have thirteen hearts
but not a single other organ.
What am I?

I'm a tree you can carry
right in your hand.
What am I?

I begin with T, end with T,
and I'm full of T.
What am I?

Forwards I am heavy,
but backwards I am not.
What word am I?

I'm the only common word
with three double letters in a row.
What am I?

I'm a five-letter word that becomes
shorter when you add two letters.
What am I?

I have a ring but no finger,
and when I ring, you answer.
What am I?

What two things
can you never eat for breakfast?

The more of me there is,
the less you can see.
What am I?

I sit between your ears
and grow sharper the more you use me.
What am I?

I have a heart
but I have never loved.
What am I?

I have many branches
but no fruit, trunk, or leaves.
What am I?

Tell me
and you no longer have me.
What am I?

You can spend me, save me, or waste me,
but you can never get me back.
What am I?

I'm always coming
but I never arrive.
What am I?

I visit you at night
and vanish by morning,
yet I feel completely real.
What am I?

The more I'm blown,
the more attention I draw.
What am I?

I have eight legs
but spin no wheels,
yet I weave a home from thread.
What am I?

I have days and weeks and months,
but not a single meal.
What am I?

I'm found in every sea
and on every table.
Too much of me spoils the meal.
What am I?

Hit me on the head
and I'll hold two things as one.
What am I?

I have many teeth
but never bite,
yet I hold your coat together.
What am I?

A man celebrates his birthday
only once every four years,
yet he is not young.
How?

I contain twenty-six letters,
yet I am only three syllables long.
What am I?

I have six faces
and twenty-one eyes,
yet I cannot see.
What am I?

The one who makes me doesn't want me.
The one who buys me doesn't need me.
The one who uses me never knows.
What am I?

I stand without ever growing.
My roots are never seen.
I'm older than the forests
and crowned in white.
What am I?

I'm a five-letter word,
yet remove four letters
and I still sound the same.
What am I?

I have a head and a tail,
I'm brown and small,
and a hundred of me make a dollar.
What am I?

A man pushes his car to a hotel
and instantly loses his fortune.
What happened?

You can serve me,
but you must never eat me.
What am I?

A cowboy rides into town on Friday,
stays three days,
and rides out again on Friday.
How?

Two fathers and two sons
go fishing, and each catches a fish,
yet only three fish are caught.
How?

You can hold me in your left hand
but never in your right.
What am I?

A boat full of people sails by,
yet there's not a single person aboard.
How?

Which word
is always spelled incorrectly?

If two's company
and three's a crowd,
what are four and five?

I can make you laugh or weep,
I'm born in an instant,
yet I can last a lifetime.
What am I?

I'm lighter than a feather,
yet no one can hold me
for more than a few minutes.
What am I?

I can be set, broken, or played,
yet I am never touched.
What am I?

A woman falls from a tall ladder
yet isn't hurt at all.
How?
riddles.answer: she fell from the bottom rung
accept: she was on the bottom rung
she fell off the bottom rung

riddles.riddle:
In the morning I walk on four,
at noon on two,
and in the evening on three.
What am I?

I have a neck but no head,
two arms but no hands.
What am I?

What kind of room
has no doors and no windows?

I can be measured,
yet I have no length, width, or height.
What am I?

I appear once in a year,
twice in a week,
but never in a day.
What am I?

I'm a six-letter word.
Remove one letter
and twelve remain.
What am I?

I can be cracked, made, told, or played.
What am I?

I always come down
but never go up.
What am I?

I run all the way around a house
yet never move a step.
What am I?

Where does today
come before yesterday?

I'm an odd number.
Take away one letter
and I become even.
What am I?

I leave a mark wherever I go
and grow shorter as I'm used.
A rubber undoes my work.
What am I?

I tick upon your wrist all day
and tell you when it's time.
What am I?

I have a sharp edge and a handle,
and I slice your bread and meat.
What am I?

Two blades joined at the hip,
I cut but I am not a knife.
What am I?

I visit your mouth twice a day
to keep your smile clean,
yet I am not food.
What am I?

The more I wash, the smaller I get,
and I leave you clean and fresh.
What am I?

I am water turned hard and cold,
and I melt away in the sun.
What am I?

I buzz from flower to flower,
I make honey, and I can sting.
What am I?

I have rungs but I am not a wheel,
and I help you climb up high.
What am I?

Beat me and I make a sound.
I am hollow, round, and loud.
What am I?

I dance in the sky on a string
whenever the wind will blow.
What am I?

I come as a pair on your feet,
soft and warm inside your shoes.
What am I?

I wave in the wind on a pole,
and I stand for a country.
What am I?

I carry my house on my back,
and I am terribly slow.
What am I?

I need air to live,
but water is my death.
Feed me and I grow;
give me a drink and I die.
What am I?

I hold great ships in place.
I am heavy, and I sink to hold.
What am I?

I connect two sides
and let you cross the water
without ever getting wet.
What am I?

I always point to the north
and guide the lost back home.
What am I?

Turn me over and sand will run
to measure the passing time.
What am I?

I pull metal toward myself
without ever touching it.
What am I?

I freeze a single moment
so you can keep it forever.
What am I?

I keep your door shut tight,
and only a key sets me free.
What am I?

Many links make me strong,
and I bind and pull as one.
What am I?

I go round and round all day,
and the open road is my home.
What am I?

I store up power for later
and slowly I run down.
What am I?

I sleep for years, then wake
to pour out fire and ash.
What am I?

I rise when it is hot
and fall when it is cold,
yet I have no legs at all.
What am I?

I am the quietest way to speak,
meant for one ear alone.
What am I?

I pull everything down to earth,
yet you can never see me.
What am I?

I spread from mouth to mouth,
often untrue and hard to stop.
What am I?

I am born inside your mind,
and I can change the whole world.
What am I?

I can fill a whole room,
yet I weigh nothing at all.
What am I?

I rise from a fire without form,
and the wind can scatter me away.
What am I?

A plane crashes exactly on the border
of two countries.
Where do you bury the survivors?

I am a five-letter word.
Remove two letters
and only one remains.
What am I?

Which is heavier:
a pound of feathers
or a pound of bricks?

How many months of the year
have twenty-eight days?

A rooster sits on the peak of a barn
and lays an egg.
Which way does it roll?

I read the same forwards, backwards,
and even upside down.
What four-letter word am I?

There are three apples in a bowl
and you take away two.
How many do you have?

Brothers and sisters I have none,
but this man's father
is my father's son.
Who is the man in the picture?

I am a nine-letter word.
Take away my whole
and some of me still remains.
What am I?

I hang down through the winter
and drip away in the spring,
made of frozen water.
What am I?

The harder you struggle against me,
the faster you sink.
What am I?

I have branches and I have leaves,
but no bark and no wood.
You'll find me in your family.
What am I?

A woman has seven daughters,
and each daughter has one brother.
How many children are there?

Before Mount Everest was ever discovered,
what was the tallest mountain on Earth?

I have a bottom at my very top.
What am I?
